title: Market Research slice summary (mr.summary/1)
description: Current-period metrics for every card played in one slice (side x ban list x tier group). Ratios are precomputed from the additive counts in trends.json.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

side.description: Side this slice covers: corp or runner.

restriction.description: Ban list of this slice: a NetrunnerDB Standard restriction ID (e.g. standard_ban_list_26_05), or all for every ban list combined.

tier_group.description: Tier group of this slice (an id from the manifest's tier_groups, e.g. gnk, store, megacity, online), or all for every tier combined.

period.description: Current period: the last period_months months (manifest) up to the slice's latest month with decks. Null when the slice has no decks. The top-cut file uses the same period as the all-decks file.

from.description: First month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

to.description: Last month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

previous_period.description: The period of the same length just before period, which change_pp compares with. Null when the slice has no decks in it.

from.description: First month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

to.description: Last month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

baseline.description: Totals for the whole side in the slice's current period, which the card metrics are divided by or compared with. In the top-cut file (cut/summary.json), over the decks that made the cut.

decks.description: Legal decks of this side. The denominator of popularity.

games.description: Games where this side's deck is known and legal, excluding intentional draws. The population card winrates are compared with.

wins.description: Wins in those games; a draw counts as half a win.

entries_hc.description: Entries with a legal deck for this side in high-coverage tournaments (decklist coverage at least thresholds.coverage_hc and a top cut), so decks that missed the cut are known as well as those that made it.

cut_hc.description: Of those entries, the ones that made the top cut.

cut_rate.description: cut_hc / entries_hc (0-1): the side's average top-cut rate. Null without entries.

tournaments.description: Tournaments in the slice's current period.

tournaments_hc.description: Of those, the high-coverage tournaments (the ones conversion uses).

games_all.description: Every game this side played in the slice, whether or not its deck is known, excluding intentional draws. In the top-cut file, every game of the players who made the cut.

wins_all.description: Wins in games_all; a draw counts as half a win.

winrate_all.description: wins_all / games_all (0-1): the headline side winrate, so Corp and Runner add up to 100%. Null without games.

faction_decks.description: Decks per identity faction (NetrunnerDB faction ID), adding up to decks. A card's in-faction popularity divides by the decks of its faction, its out-of-faction popularity by decks minus those.

cards.description: Every card played in the current or previous period, most played first. A card played only in the previous period is listed with 0 decks so it can show up as a faller.

card_id.description: Card ID from the catalog (the NetrunnerDB card ID, the same across printings).

rank.description: Position by decks in the current period (1 = most played; ties by card_id). Null for a card not played in the current period.

decks.description: Decks playing the card in the current period.

popularity.description: decks / baseline.decks (0-1): the share of the side's decks that play the card.

avg_copies.description: Average copies of the card in the decks that play it. Null when no deck plays it.

copies_mode.description: Most common copy count among the decks that play it: 1, 2 or 3 (3 = three or more; a tie picks the smaller). Null when no deck plays it.

prev_popularity.description: Popularity in previous_period (0 if the card wasn't played then). Null when there is no previous period.

change_pp.description: popularity - prev_popularity, in percentage points. Null without a previous period. Risers and fallers are ranked by it.

games.description: Games played by decks with the card, on the card's side, where the deck is known and legal, excluding intentional draws.

wins.description: Wins in those games; a draw counts as half a win.

winrate_diff_pp.description: winrate - baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

wilson_low_pp.description: Lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of winrate, minus baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null without games or without a baseline winrate.

wilson_high_pp.description: Upper bound of the Wilson 95% interval of winrate, minus baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null without games or without a baseline winrate.

winrate_status.description: ok when games is at least thresholds.min_games (manifest), otherwise insufficient: too small a sample for the winrate to be meaningful.

entries_hc.description: Entries whose deck plays the card, in high-coverage tournaments (decklist coverage at least thresholds.coverage_hc and a top cut), so decks that missed the cut are known as well as those that made it.

cut_hc.description: Of those entries, the ones that made the top cut.

tournaments_hc.description: High-coverage tournaments in which at least one deck played the card.

conversion.description: cut_hc / entries_hc (0-1): how often decks with the card made the cut. Null without entries.

conversion_ratio.description: conversion / baseline.cut_rate: 1 = the side's average, 2 = twice as likely to make the cut. Null when either is null or zero.

conversion_diff_pp.description: conversion - baseline.cut_rate, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

conversion_status.description: ok when entries_hc is at least thresholds.min_entries (manifest), otherwise insufficient: too small a sample for the conversion to be meaningful.

decks_in_faction.description: Decks playing the card whose identity has the card's faction; the other decks - decks_in_faction play it out of faction, paying influence. Null for neutral cards and identities.

popularity_in.description: decks_in_faction / baseline.faction_decks of the card's faction (0-1): the share of that faction's decks that play the card. Null without such decks. Null for neutral cards and identities.

prev_popularity_in.description: popularity_in in previous_period (0 if the card wasn't played then). Null without a previous period. Null for neutral cards and identities.

change_in_pp.description: popularity_in - prev_popularity_in, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

popularity_out.description: (decks - decks_in_faction) / (baseline.decks - decks of the card's faction) (0-1): the share of the other factions' decks that splash the card. Null without such decks. Null for neutral cards, identities and agendas (an agenda can only be played in its own faction).

prev_popularity_out.description: popularity_out in previous_period (0 if the card wasn't played then). Null without a previous period. Null for neutral cards, identities and agendas (an agenda can only be played in its own faction).

change_out_pp.description: popularity_out - prev_popularity_out, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

splash_share.description: (decks - decks_in_faction) / decks (0-1): of the decks playing the card, the share that play it out of faction. Null when no deck plays it. Null for neutral cards, identities and agendas (an agenda can only be played in its own faction).

prev_splash_share.description: splash_share in previous_period. Null when the card wasn't played then or there is no previous period. Null for neutral cards, identities and agendas (an agenda can only be played in its own faction).

change_splash_pp.description: splash_share - prev_splash_share, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

splash_status.description: ok when decks is at least thresholds.min_splash_decks (manifest), otherwise insufficient: too few decks for the splash share to be meaningful. Null for neutral cards, identities and agendas (an agenda can only be played in its own faction).

risers.description: Up to ten card IDs with the largest positive change_pp, largest first.

fallers.description: Up to ten card IDs with the largest negative change_pp, largest drop first.
